notes: There is no single fixed legal font size; disclosures must be clear and conspicuous based on context and device size.
Small print must be legible and prominent enough to qualify claims; avoid tiny type or low-contrast presentation.
Use high contrast and avoid burying or minimizing qualifying information.
commonPrinciples: Disclosures and qualifications must be clear and conspicuous.
Qualifying information should be close to the claim it qualifies and near the ad's focal point.
Avoid small type or styling that makes disclosures hard to read.
Use strong contrast and legible fonts.
Avoid misleading overall impressions; disclosures must not contradict headline claims.

customOverrides.description: Developer preferences that override default styling choices.

ukPriorityProhibitions: Avoid drip pricing; include mandatory fees in the total price shown.
Qualifications must be sufficiently prominent and cannot contradict headline claims.

onMatch.message: Background and text colors cannot be the same for the same variation.
